title: Recipes
description: data/tokenRecipes.json: every recipe in one flat list; the workspace holds the same recipes in recipePools, one list per skill. Loaded by src/config/registries/recipePoolRegistry.js (a station draws every recipe of the skill its station rule names); authored in cms/src/components/editors/RecipeEditor.jsx. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings (unknown keys), not errors.

id.description: Unique and stable: a placed station saves the recipe it works as selectedRecipeId (src/systems/board/StationRecipe.js).

skill.description: The skill pool it belongs to (recipePoolRegistry.js); a skill id.

levelRequirement.description: The worker's level in the skill (StationRecipe.js).

requiresContext.description: Nearby capabilities it needs (recipePoolRegistry.js contextRequirementsOf; Charges.js): { tag, minTier } or a bare tag string (tier 1). chargeCost is never read.

inputs.description: Paid each cycle (RecipeResolver.js); for a crop, the seeds, paid once per sowing.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds a cycle; overrides the station's cycleTimeMs. Derived from Tempo by Recalculate.

stationChargeCost.description: Station charges a cycle spends (cycleCharges.js, default 1); 0 on a Foundation.

xp.description: XP a cycle; derived by Recalculate unless sim.xpPinned.

stationKinds.description: STATION_KINDS (src/config/registries/tokenConstants.js): which stations of the skill offer it; empty means all of them.

foundationKinds.description: FOUNDATION_KINDS: a building recipe offered on these Foundations, kept out of station pools (recipePoolRegistry.js).

foundationMinTier.description: The lowest Foundation tier that offers it (tokenConstants.js foundationMinTierOf).

crop.description: A crop sown on a field (tokenConstants.js cropTermsOf; src/systems/board/Fields.js).
